registry_metadata.purpose: Static resource registry separating MODEL/ROLE -> ACCESS_SURFACE -> QUOTA_POOL (issue #32/#37). Static capabilities and relationships only; no dynamic quota values.

compatibility.resources_projection: resources is the canonical resource-registry-v1 object preserved verbatim for v1 consumers until they are migrated. v1 consumers must not read models/access_surfaces/quota_pools.
compatibility.removal_policy: The resources projection is removed only by a later separately governed pass after all v1 consumers are migrated.

registry_metadata.dynamic_data_policy: No dynamic quota/usage/reset values are permitted in this static registry. Quota state belongs to resource-status observations (source: dashboard_snapshot / provider_api / internal_ledger / local_probe / manual) under docs/contracts/resource-status-v1.schema.json.

model_selection_policy.note: Codex model identities (e.g. Sol/Terra/Luna/Astra observed 2026-09-05) are provider-managed and must be resolved at selection time from current client/runtime evidence; this registry deliberately does NOT freeze them as a permanent list.
Concrete Qwen profile IDs remain owned by the Qwen local runtime (configs/resources/qwen-local-runtime.json + qwen-models.ini); this registry does not duplicate them.
Model identities offered by the Codex IDE extension are refreshable; resolve from current extension/runtime evidence, never frozen here.

qualification.note: Issue #34 qualification completed 2026-09-05: official Codex IDE extension installed in Cursor; authenticated via ChatGPT Plus subscription (NOT OpenAI API key); model/reasoning UI inventory verified live; bounded repo-read PASS; TASK DELTA generation PASS; fail-closed stale-HEAD behavior PASS; bounded real edit + Git push PASS (commit ad3e5cb 'codex-ide-proof: V4_CODEX_IDE_CURSOR_BOUNDED_EDIT_V1'); quota/usage dashboard source observed. Evidence: reports/architecture/v4_codex_ide_cursor_live_qualification.md + provenance commit ad3e5cb. Runtime qualification is separate from quota collection: no live automatic quota collector exists yet; quota state remains governed by resource-status-v1 observations and stays fail-closed/unknown without a fresh valid observation.

model_selection_policy.note: Selected model + selected reasoning/quality effort are per-invocation route metadata (issue #32 A.1/G), not registry constants.

qualification.note: Codex CLI/OAuth no-op PASS and controlled repo-read PASS already evidenced; see MULTI_PLANNER_CURSOR_LOOP_OPERATING_MODEL.md.

openai_api_route.note: Explicitly NOT an available route. No OpenAI API-key / BYOK / API-billing access surface is authorized in this control plane; this entry exists only so fail-closed checks and tests can assert its absence. No surface of this name may be created without a separately governed authorization pass.

model_selection_policy.note: glm-5.3 and glm-5.3-flash are distinct selectable model identities; both consume the same pool.

qualification.note: GLM planner/implementation already live via Cursor BYOK per MULTI_PLANNER_CURSOR_LOOP_OPERATING_MODEL.md.

allowance_ownership.note: Composer/native Cursor allowance ownership is NOT verified for the installed plan; no pool identity or numbers are invented (issue #32 C / #37). A pool may be attached later only from fresh verified account evidence.

model_selection_policy.note: Cursor model inventory is refreshable/versioned; historical model lists must not be frozen here.

cursor_byok_route.note: BYOK consumption belongs to the external provider pool (glm_coding_plan), never to Cursor included quota unless verified otherwise.

opencode_local_harness.note: OpenCode is the current local DEV harness for Qwen local models. Local compute is unmetered local semantics; no commercial token pool is modeled.

glm_coding_plan.note: glm-5.3 and glm-5.3-flash draw from ONE shared allowance; their quotas must never be double-counted as independent model quotas. Per-surface attribution may be tracked later by collectors, not by duplicating pool quota.
